text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with Rulership as the leader—
turned out to be on a whole different level compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-senpai! I want to catch our opponents off guard
and make everyone go "woaaah"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But we need to dig a layer deeper.
What is the true intention behind wanting to surprise them?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
True motive... um... Oh, I see!
If you only surprise them and end up losing...

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Um, I thought my pacing
felt pretty good, though!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Looking solely at the running, that's true.
However, have you considered the impact on those around you?

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sister B
text_block_list.text: Me too! There's something I want you to hear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through the repeated rounds of questions and answers,
each of their individual challenges became clearer.
And then, that was...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I see... So this is how it works...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I understand the content I am to impart,
of course. However...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(By verbalizing concepts for others, one's own understanding deepens...
Ah, the protégé effect at work.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to conquer all eras. That connects to
my power now. That's right, to the current me—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I can see it... the surging swells of time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because I am mindful of history that I know
'what needs to be done' in this modern era..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this'll work. With this, without fail.
Now that I'm aiming to conquer all eras—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My perspective has been elevated
from that of an "individual" to that of a "division commander."
And so—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: She learned to view herself calmly, as just one unit within the whole collective.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: With this perspective, no matter how formidable the opponent, no matter how much pressure the race brings—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I will never lose sight of who I am again.
Thanks to... you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In the Twinkle Series, fighting as a division is effective.
Thanks to your idea, I have arrived at that strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: This game... is ours now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-senpai...
Then what about the Arima Kinen?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we can definitely win.
The ones standing at the top in the year-end Arima Kinen... will be us—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's the Rulership Squad!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ruler... Ship Brigade, huh.
Heh, hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, wait a second.
I feel like that's kinda lame...
Like something out of a children's manga...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Rulership Squad, assemble!!

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sisters
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't make it a done deal! Attention, everyone!
Listen to your commandeeeer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite the chaos,
everyone gradually became one.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Rulership-san and the others...
So... that's how it turned out...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
True strength lies in the pack.
Few ever arrive at that way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Looks like they'll be a formidable rival for us—and for you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is beyond question.
The path to coronation has already been revealed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
In every era, there is only one who rules.
Namely—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A "King".

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right.
Let's make sure... they find out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Individual races. And then—team races.
Heading toward the end of the year,
the competition accelerated even further."
